body.text: You will hear it from the ports before you hear it from me, so I will be plain: I have given orders to raise the duty on {param:resource}.
I did not ask you. The Crown has stopped honouring what you pledge, and I have said for a year what the colony's returns wanted. I have now done it.
You may write to countermand me. I would ask you to read the ledger first.
